list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT host_name FROM siem.events WHERE ingested > now() - INTERVAL 5 DAY ORDER BY host_name
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT host_name FROM siem.events WHERE ingested > now() - INTERVAL 5 DAY ORDER BY host_name

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS zdarzenia FROM siem.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND host_name IN (${host:singlequote})
SELECT uniqExact(agent_id) AS agenci FROM siem.events WHERE ingested > now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
SELECT count() AS nieudane FROM siem.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND event_action = 'logon-failed' AND host_name IN (${host:singlequote})
SELECT count() AS kwarantanna FROM siem.quarantine WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested)

panels.title: Agenci – ostatnio widziani
panels.description: Agent, od którego od dłuższego czasu nic nie przyszło, może być wyłączony lub odinstalowany.

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent_id AS agent, any(host_name) AS host, max(ingested) AS ostatnio, dateDiff('minute', max(ingested), now()) AS minut_temu, count() AS zdarzen_5d FROM siem.events WHERE ingested > now() - INTERVAL 5 DAY GROUP BY agent_id ORDER BY ostatnio

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, event_dataset, count() AS c FROM siem.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND host_name IN (${host:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, event_dataset ORDER BY time

SELECT user_domain AS domena, user_name AS konto, replaceOne(toString(source_ip), '::ffff:', '') AS ip, host_name AS host, count() AS prob, min(timestamp) AS pierwsza, max(timestamp) AS ostatnia FROM siem.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND event_action IN ('logon-failed', 'kerberos-preauth-failed') AND host_name IN (${host:singlequote}) GROUP BY domena, konto, ip, host ORDER BY prob DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT event_dataset AS zrodlo, event_code AS kod, event_action AS akcja, any(event_provider) AS dostawca, count() AS liczba FROM siem.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND host_name IN (${host:singlequote}) GROUP BY zrodlo, kod, akcja ORDER BY liczba DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Ostatnie zdarzenia
panels.description: Pole „Szukaj w treści” filtruje po surowym XML zdarzenia (bez rozróżniania wielkości liter).

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS czas, host_name AS host, event_dataset AS zrodlo, event_code AS kod, event_action AS akcja, event_outcome AS wynik, user_name AS konto, replaceOne(toString(source_ip), '::ffff:', '') AS ip, process_name AS proces, message AS komunikat, event_id FROM siem.events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND host_name IN (${host:singlequote}) AND (${szukaj:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(raw, ${szukaj:sqlstring}) > 0) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT source AS zrodlo, reason AS powod, count() AS liczba, max(ingested) AS ostatnio, any(substring(raw, 1, 200)) AS przyklad FROM siem.quarantine WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested) GROUP BY zrodlo, powod ORDER BY liczba DESC LIMIT 50
